learning_outcomes.text: Define the near field equations to determine the stress-strain and load-displacement fields around a crack tip for linear elastic cases.
Identify and formulate the stress intensity factor (K) for typical crack configurations.
Identify and formulate the strain energy release rate (G).
Identify and formulate J-integral and the stress and strain fields around a crack tip for non linear and elastoplastic materials.
Define fracture toughness of materials using Kc, Gc and Jc.
Employ the standard and non standard fracture mechanics tests to determine the fracture toughness of materials.
Predict the fatigue life of structures using fracture mechanics approaches.
To provide an understanding of fundamental principles and assumptions.
To give a basis for analysis.
Evaluation of structures from a fracture mechanics point of view.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to failure and fracture of engineering materials
Stress intensity and strain energy release rate approaches to brittle fracture
Dugdale and Irwin approaches to ductile fracture
bibliography: Principles of Fracture Mechanics, R.J. Sanford, 2003, Pearson Education Inc.
